chunks.subject: AP Physics C: Mechanics
chunks.title: Q4 Qualitative Quantitative Translation (QQT) — 8 points
chunks.content: AP Physics C: Mechanics FRQ 4 is Qualitative Quantitative Translation (QQT), 8 points, scored by lettered sub-points. The QQT task connects qualitative reasoning with quantitative analysis around a claim. Q4 topic: rotation with friction (a disk/rotational dynamics — torque, moment of inertia, angular momentum). Points reward: a correct claim/prediction, qualitative reasoning citing the relevant rotational principle (torque, conservation of angular momentum), a consistent quantitative derivation, and agreement between the qualitative and quantitative arguments. Common failure: a claim without a supporting principle; quantitative work inconsistent with the qualitative reasoning; confusing linear and rotational quantities.

chunks.content: Q4 (QQT) scored 4/8 — earned the claim and some qualitative reasoning but lost points where the quantitative argument was incomplete or inconsistent with the claim (e.g., mixing linear and rotational quantities). Illustrates a half-connected response.

chunks.content: Q4 (QQT) scored 3/8 — earned a few sub-points (a claim and one or two reasoning/quantitative steps), losing most of the principle-based reasoning and quantitative support. Illustrates a response that only partially links qualitative and quantitative rotational reasoning.
